record.bible_text: Now after<WH0310> the death<WH04194> of Moses<WH04872> the servant<WH05650> of the LORD<WH03068> it came to pass, that the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Joshua<WH03091> the son<WH01121> of Nun<WH05126>, Moses<WH04872>' minister<WH08334><WTH8764>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Every place<WH04725> that the sole<WH03709> of your foot<WH07272> shall tread upon<WH01869><WTH8799>, that have I given<WH05414><WTH8804> unto you, as I said<WH01696><WTH8765> unto Moses<WH04872>.

From the wilderness<WH04057> and this Lebanon<WH03844> even unto the great<WH01419> river<WH05104>, the river<WH05104> Euphrates<WH06578>, all the land<WH0776> of the Hittites<WH02850>, and unto the great<WH01419> sea<WH03220> toward the going down<WH03996> of the sun<WH08121>, shall be your coast<WH01366>.

There shall not any man<WH0376> be able to stand<WH03320><WTH8691> before<WH06440> thee all the days<WH03117> of thy life<WH02416>: as I was with Moses<WH04872>, <FI>so<Fi> I will be with thee: I will not fail<WH07503><WTH8686> thee, nor forsake<WH05800><WTH8799> thee.

Be strong<WH02388><WTH8798> and of a good courage<WH0553><WTH8798>: for unto this people<WH05971> shalt thou divide for an inheritance<WH05157><WTH8686> the land<WH0776>, which I sware<WH07650><WTH8738> unto their fathers<WH01> to give<WH05414><WTH8800> them. <RF>unto this...: or, thou shalt cause this people to inherit the land, etc<Rf>

Only be thou strong<WH02388><WTH8798> and very<WH03966> courageous<WH0553><WTH8798>, that thou mayest observe<WH08104><WTH8800> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> according to all the law<WH08451>, which Moses<WH04872> my servant<WH05650> commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> thee: turn<WH05493><WTH8799> not from it <FI>to<Fi> the right hand<WH03225> or <FI>to<Fi> the left<WH08040>, that thou mayest prosper<WH07919><WTH8686> whithersoever thou goest<WH03212><WTH8799>. <RF>prosper: or, do wisely<Rf>

This book<WH05612> of the law<WH08451> shall not depart<WH04185><WTH8799> out of thy mouth<WH06310>; but thou shalt meditate<WH01897><WTH8804> therein day<WH03119> and night<WH03915>, that thou mayest observe<WH08104><WTH8799> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> according to all that is written<WH03789><WTH8803> therein: for then thou shalt make<WH06743><WH00> thy way<WH01870> prosperous<WH06743><WTH8686>, and then thou shalt have good success<WH07919><WTH8686>. <RF>have...: or, do wisely<Rf>

Have not I commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> thee? Be strong<WH02388><WTH8798> and of a good courage<WH0553><WTH8798>; be not afraid<WH06206><WTH8799>, neither be thou dismayed<WH02865><WTH8735>: for the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> with thee whithersoever thou goest<WH03212><WTH8799>.<CM>
Then Joshua<WH03091> commanded<WH06680><WTH8762> the officers<WH07860><WTH8802> of the people<WH05971>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Pass<WH05674><WTH8798> through<WH07130> the host<WH04264>, and command<WH06680><WTH8761> the people<WH05971>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Prepare<WH03559><WTH8685> you victuals<WH06720>; for within three<WH07969> days<WH03117> ye shall pass over<WH05674><WTH8802> this Jordan<WH03383>, to go in<WH0935><WTH8800> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> the land<WH0776>, which the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> you to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> it.
And to the Reubenites<WH07206>, and to the Gadites<WH01425>, and to half<WH02677> the tribe<WH07626> of Manasseh<WH04519>, spake<WH0559><WTH8804> Joshua<WH03091>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Remember<WH02142><WTH8800> the word<WH01697> which Moses<WH04872> the servant<WH05650> of the LORD<WH03068> commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> you, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, The LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> hath given you rest<WH05117><WTH8688>, and hath given<WH05414><WTH8804> you this land<WH0776>.

Your wives<WH0802>, your little ones<WH02945>, and your cattle<WH04735>, shall remain<WH03427><WTH8799> in the land<WH0776> which Moses<WH04872> gave<WH05414><WTH8804> you on this side<WH05676> Jordan<WH03383>; but ye shall pass<WH05674><WTH8799> before<WH06440> your brethren<WH0251> armed<WH02571>, all the mighty<WH01368> men of valour<WH02428>, and help<WH05826><WTH8804> them; <RF>armed: Heb. marshalled by five<Rf>

Until the LORD<WH03068> have given<WH05117><WH00> your brethren<WH0251> rest<WH05117><WTH8686>, as <FI>he hath given<Fi> you, and they also have possessed<WH03423><WTH8804> the land<WH0776> which the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> them: then ye shall return<WH07725><WTH8804> unto the land<WH0776> of your possession<WH03425>, and enjoy<WH03423><WTH8804> it, which Moses<WH04872> the LORD'S<WH03068> servant<WH05650> gave<WH05414><WTH8804> you on this side<WH05676> Jordan<WH03383> toward the sunrising<WH04217><WH08121>.<CM>

And they answered<WH06030><WTH8799> Joshua<WH03091>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, All that thou commandest<WH06680><WTH8765> us we will do<WH06213><WTH8799>, and whithersoever<WH0834> thou sendest<WH07971><WTH8799> us, we will go<WH03212><WTH8799>.

According as we hearkened<WH08085><WTH8804> unto Moses<WH04872> in all things, so will we hearken<WH08085><WTH8799> unto thee: only the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> be with thee, as he was with Moses<WH04872>.

Whosoever<WH0376> <FI>he be<Fi> that doth rebel<WH04784><WTH8686> against thy commandment<WH06310>, and will not hearken<WH08085><WTH8799> unto thy words<WH01697> in all that thou commandest<WH06680><WTH8762> him, he shall be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714>: only be strong<WH02388><WTH8798> and of a good courage<WH0553><WTH8798>.<CM>
